For bounded smooth increasing centered h(x), m(x)=E[log j(x,Y)] is strictly decreasing and covariance negative, giving a strictly positive coefficient B. KL<=4ε²/(1-ε), hence dH/dt>0 for sufficiently small ε for every p,c>0. Smooth positivity, mass, tails, quantifiers and normalization are explicit. The packaged symbolic/quadrature checker ran successfully, with quadrature used only to corroborate analytic signs.
